name: gutenprint-cups package split
description: On Alpine, Gutenprint is split: 'gutenprint' (libs/tools) vs 'gutenprint-cups' (CUPS filters rastertogutenprint + PPDs under /usr/share/cups/model, community repo, arch=all). To make Canon/HP/Brother/etc models appear in the CUPS add-printer list, install gutenprint-cups in addition to gutenprint (verified for PR #33: v3.23 5.3.5-r0, ~51MiB compressed/~71MiB installed).

outcomes.test_results: Alpine 3.24 chroot: cmake build OK; ctest 4/4 passed; validate_addon.py + shellcheck OK

name: brlaser (Brother GDI) build on Alpine
description: Owl-Maintain/brlaser v6.2.8 (GPL-2.0) builds cleanly on Alpine 3.24 with cmake, g++, make and cups-dev. Configure with -DCUPS_DATA_DIR=/usr/share/cups -DCUPS_SERVER_BIN=/usr/lib/cups; it installs /usr/lib/cups/filter/rastertobrlaser plus /usr/share/cups/drv/brlaser.drv, and all four upstream ctest suites pass. The vendored tree matches the v6.2.8 tarball byte-for-byte.

name: cups-bjnp 2.0.3 build on Alpine
description: cups-bjnp 2.0.3 (Canon BJNP backend, port 8611) builds cleanly on Alpine 3.24 with build-base + cups-dev. The Debian orig tarball SHA-256 is c914b2fd9d8e26ce22f2df6244d9defeec31ee9a5360f723eecb3b00f2168500. Configure with --prefix=/usr --with-cupsbackenddir=/usr/lib/cups/backend --disable-Werror (GCC warns on unused vars and a dangling pointer in bjnp-levels.c, so -Werror would fail). The only build artifact needed is bjnp, installed to /usr/lib/cups/backend/bjnp; runtime deps (libcups, avahi, gnutls, etc.) come from the existing cups package. Verified by compiling all 8 sources manually against Alpine 3.24 cups-dev.
